The performance of our Investment segment’s short positions was primarily driven by net losses in the energy sector of $1.2 billion related to losses on refining hedges. , which represent certain equity and commodity derivative positions intended to serve as economic hedges against the value of CVR Energy, and net losses from broad market hedges of $269 million.

Pursuant to previously announced settlement agreements, in 2025, two competitors launched competing generic products to the patent protected weight loss treatment sold within our Pharma segment in the United States, which has caused, and we anticipate will continue to cause, a moderate reduction of prescription volume in the retail pharmacy market in the United States.
We anticipate these new launches will eventually offset the lost revenue in the United States.

We currently expect to satisfy the 2027 Notes at or prior to maturity through one or more refinancing transactions permitted under our existing indentures, cash on hand, redemptions of our interests in the Investment Funds or a combination of these sources.
There can be no assurance that we will be able to refinance the 2027 Notes on acceptable terms or at all.

Based on our current cash and cash equivalents, our interests in the Investment Funds and our other anticipated sources of liquidity, we believe we have sufficient liquidity to meet our obligations, including repayment or refinancing of the 2027 Notes, for at least the next 12 months.

No assurance can be made that any or all amounts will be sold during the term of the agreement, and we have no obligation to sell additional depositary units under the 2024 Open Market Sale Agreement.
